### Step 1 — Scene
A chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry with rice and brown sauce, accompanied by a small fruit salad and a cup of orange juice.

### Step 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **25 cm diameter**, area **491 cm²**.
- Fruit bowl: approximately **11 cm diameter**, opening area **95 cm²**.
- Juice cup: approximately **7 cm internal diameter**, with about **7.5 cm liquid depth**.

### Steps 3–6 — Items, area, volume, and weight
For the overlapping stir-fry ingredients, the percentages below divide the occupied plate area into non-overlapping equivalent portions.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area | Typical height | Gross volume | Density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 24% of plate | 118 cm² | 1.8 cm | 212 ml | 0.8 g/ml | 170 g |
| Chicken pieces | 20% of plate | 98 cm² | 1.4 cm | 137 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 130 g |
| Vegetables: green beans, carrots, likely mushrooms/onion | 14% of plate | 69 cm² | 1.5 cm | 104 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 62 g |
| Brown stir-fry sauce | 6% of plate | 29 cm² | 0.5 cm | 15 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 15 g |
| Mixed fruit: melon, grapes, and dark berries | 90% of bowl | 86 cm² | 2.2 cm | 189 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 113 g |
| Orange juice | 100% of cup cross-section | 38.5 cm² | 7.5 cm | 289 ml | 1.04 g/ml | 300 g |

**Coverage check:** Main-plate portions total **64%**, consistent with the substantial uncovered rim. Fruit fills about **90%** of its bowl opening. Any cooking oil is included in the chicken, vegetables, and sauce energy estimates rather than counted separately.

### Step 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 130 | 221 |
| Chicken pieces, cooked with some oil | 185 | 241 |
| Cooked mixed vegetables | 45 | 28 |
| Brown stir-fry sauce | 100 | 15 |
| Mixed fruit | 45 | 51 |
| Orange juice | 45 | 135 |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
The main plate contains approximately **377 g**, a plausible amount for the visible mound. Including fruit and juice gives approximately **790 g and 690 kcal**. The largest uncertainties are the depth of rice beneath the stir-fry and the sauce’s oil content.
